dina: noticed a weird interaction on Console > Integrations: when the compact modal (confirm delete) appears and a toast fires at bottom-right, the toast overlaps the modal's action row and steals taps on the "Delete" button on mobile. hit delete twice and the toast dismissed the modal instead :sweat_smile:
otto: can repro on iPhone simulator. looks like our toast anchor sits over the modal when spacing tokens are compact.
rebekah: interesting edge-case. we tightened spacing tokens to support compact dashboards, but didn’t account for stacked surfaces. options: move toast anchor, elevate modal z-index, or add safe-zone CSS to modal action row. prefer safe-zone so toasts can stay anchored global.
dina: safe-zone sounds good. maybe add a transparent padding-bottom via a spacing token override on modal actions when a toast is present. but i want to avoid changing core tokens globally.
otto: local solution: `.modal__actions { padding-bottom: env(toast-safe-area, 12px); }` then when toast shown set `--toast-safe-area: 44px` on body. or simpler: toggled class `.toast-visible` on body that increases modal action hit area.
rebekah: quick CSS idea:
```css
.toast-visible .modal .modal-actions { padding-bottom: 48px; }
.toast { pointer-events: auto; }
.modal .modal-actions button { z-index: 5; position: relative; }
```
But make sure modal actions stay above toast for keyboard and screen reader users.
ux-bot: accessibility note: do not hide or move focusable controls under transient UI. if toasts can appear overlapping important controls, ensure toasts are non-modal and use `pointer-events: none` unless hovered/focused, or move them to an alternate anchor on small viewports. Also ensure any added padding doesn’t shift content unexpectedly for screen magnification.
dina: another copy nudge: when a toast overlaps a modal action the visual can be confusing; consider toast copy that references the context ("Template deleted" vs just "Deleted") so users know what changed without interacting. also ARIA live regions should be polite.
otto: action items: 1) frontend: prototype `.toast-visible` approach that adds local safe-zone to modal action rows and test on iPhone simulator; 2) design: propose alternate toast anchors for small screens (bottom-center vs bottom-right) and draft contextual toast copy variants.
rebekah: i'll mock the bottom-center anchor and a safe-zone variant; posting screenshots by Thu.
ux-bot: summary: avoid changing global spacing tokens; add local safe-zone to modal action rows when toast present or move toast anchor on small screens; ensure toasts are non-intrusive to focus and use contextual copy. :white_check_mark:
